description: SFLOW 1D channel over a bump, dx 0.5 m, explicit horizontal diffusion (A 212 1) with W 2 5 m2/s, RK2 (A 210 2): the time step is set by the viscosity, dt = 0.2 dx^2/nu = 0.01 s (the normal stress diffuses with 2 nu). With the limit 0.5 dx^2/nu the run was unstable (velocities of both signs along the channel).
covers: sflow_etimestep: viscous time step limit of the explicit diffusion
